TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Molucca Sea
DATE 5 November 2028 · 0710 local
SIDE People's Liberation Army Navy
WINDOW 70 min, closes at 105
Type 003 Fujian carrier. Photo: China News Service · CC BY 4.0 · cropped
"It's not enough to talk about deterrence: I believe we must demonstrate that we can deliver air power to degrade, disrupt, destroy, and defeat."
- Air Marshal Stephen Chappell, Chief of Air Force, RAAF, 2026

MOLUCCA SEA, 0710. The group came down from the Philippine Sea at first light, bound for its station in the Banda approaches. Last night DIPPER 21's sonar heard a diesel boat twelve miles astern of FUJIAN. She has been there since the Talaud Islands, matching the carrier's speed and keeping her distance. She is designated ALPHA.

A RAAF Poseidon is over the group and a Triton is high to the south-west. They are recording everything it does, and anything it does to that boat. A Wedgetail, well to the south, holds the coalition's air picture of all of it.

Put a class on ALPHA, so the group knows what has been following it, then take FUJIAN to her morning station, twenty-two miles down the track. Your ships and helicopters start at weapons Hold. Set them free and the ship's flight may put a torpedo on the boat without being told, and that ends the operation.

The Ternate-Bitung ferry, two tuna boats and a coaster bound north for the Sangihe islands are in the same water, and the Manado-Ambon service is in the air to the south-west. Identify before you act.
Fleet headquarters
COMMANDER'S INTENT

The group is in the approaches to protect Chinese nationals and, if asked, to bring them out. It is not at war with any state and it will not fire first. A submarine following a carrier is doing her job: know which one she is and get on with ours. Fujian arrives on station intact and on time, and nothing the Australian aircraft records today shows a Chinese weapon in the water.
• Classify ALPHA, then take Fujian south to her morning station
• Fire on nothing: not the boat, not the aircraft
• Bring Fujian through intact
• Harm no ferry, fishing boat, coaster or airliner
• Classify the patrol aircraft over the group

Your screen, with the ship's flight if one is embarked. Allocated: FUJIAN and her dipping Z-18F, Dipper 21. Watching: a RAAF P-8A, an MQ-4C Triton and, well to the south, an E-7A Wedgetail. Astern: one diesel submarine, ALPHA. Neutral: a ferry, two tuna boats, a coaster and the Manado-Ambon service.

The planned window is 70 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 35 minutes more; the operation is closed at 105 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
